notToBeConfusedWith.name: Rump steak
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Cut from the rump proper rather than the fat-capped triangular muscle sitting on top of it; picanha keeps a thick layer of fat that rump steak does not.

generalSubstitutes.substitute: beef rump cap (culotte) or, failing that, sirloin cap
generalSubstitutes.note: Picanha is the Brazilian name for the same muscle sold in other countries as rump cap or culotte.

forms.label: Raw
forms.sourceNote: USDA publishes no picanha/rump-cap record. This is its record for New Zealand rump centre, separable lean and fat — the closest whole rump-muscle profile it carries.
